summary: This topic explains how to assign specific transport routes and pick-up points to students in bulk using an Excel upload. This process links students to their transport details, automatically applying associated transport fees.
steps: Click on the 'Transport Excel Upload' option.
Fill the Excel with the following columns:
'Reg Number' (the student's unique ID or admission number).
'Vehicle Route' (the exact name of the route, e.g., Route 1).
'Pick-up Point' (the exact name of the pick-up point, e.g., Ansal).
business_rules: The system uses the student's unique 'Reg Number' to identify them.
The transport fees associated with the assigned route and pick-up point will automatically be charged to the student's fee demand.
important_notes: This feature is for bulk assignment of transport details to students.
Vehicle number is not needed in this Excel as it is already defined within the Vehicle Route setup.
Manual assignment of transport to students is also possible (though not detailed here).
